w10_T4_003342: Ola's prepaid phone plan started the month with 226 minutes of call credit. She topped it up with 35 minutes, then bought another 80 minutes, and later added 64 minutes as a promotional bonus. During the month she used 165 minutes on calls. She always tracks her credit in minutes and never converts it to hours, even though sixty minutes make one hour. How many minutes of call credit does Ola have left?
w10_T4_003346: The caretaker at Oakfield school ordered 106 boxes of chalk, but 52 boxes arrived damaged and were sent back. Each box holds 6 packs, and each pack contains 9 sticks of chalk. The caretaker also found 22 loose sticks in the cupboard. The chalk will be shared out among a dozen teachers, and the school has 14 classrooms. The catalogue lists stick length in millimetres, but the caretaker writes it down in centimetres, since ten millimetres make one centimetre. How many sticks of chalk does the caretaker have altogether?
w10_T4_003358: In the morning, a bakery made 168 large pastries and divided them equally among 3 trays, sending just 1 tray to the town fair. At the fair, each pastry on that tray was cut into 9 bite-sized pieces. By the afternoon, half of the pieces had been sold. In the evening, the pieces still unsold were shared equally among 3 food banks. The Riverside food bank also received 45 pieces from another stall. How many pieces did the Riverside food bank receive in total?
w10_T4_003366: Jonas had 72 dollars in his wallet on Monday, and he tutors twice a week. He spent 16 dollars on lunch, then was paid 68 dollars for a tutoring session. He found 11 dollars in an old jacket and added it to his wallet. Later he spent 28 dollars on a book and 68 dollars on a new pair of shoes. He counts his loose change in cents but writes his ledger in dollars, since a hundred cents make one dollar. How many dollars does Jonas have in his wallet now?
w10_T4_003373: In the morning, Mira's laundry had 103 shirts waiting to be pressed, more than the 90 shirts waiting at Vik's laundry down the street. By midday Mira had pressed and returned 74 of them. In the afternoon a hotel dropped off 34 more shirts. Mira charges 3 dollars for each shirt she presses. In the evening, the owners of every shirt still in the shop agreed to pay twice her usual price for same-day delivery, and she pressed them all. How many dollars did Mira earn from the evening pressing?
w10_T4_003375: The history shelf in the town library held 31 books on Monday, in a reading room with a dozen windows. On Tuesday 49 borrowed books were returned to the shelf. On Wednesday the librarian added 30 newly purchased books, and on Thursday a retired teacher donated 71 books to the shelf. On Friday 55 books were borrowed from it. On Saturday 3 misplaced books were found and put back on the shelf. How many books are on the history shelf now?
w10_T4_003376: Bao and his cousin Lin are both saving for laptops. Bao puts 148 dollars into his savings jar in each of 6 months, while Lin saves a total of 900 dollars over the same period, so Lin has more. Bao's grandmother then adds 40 dollars to his jar. Bao takes 869 dollars out of the jar to buy his laptop. A week later he finds 9 dollars in a coat pocket and drops it into the jar. How many dollars are in Bao's jar now?
w10_T4_003379: Kofi emptied his coin jar and counted 195 cents. He spent 21 cents on a piece of gum, then his sister paid him back 56 cents she owed him. He spent 34 cents on a sticker and 154 cents on a bus ticket for a ride that took 25 minutes. While waiting half an hour at the stop, he dropped 18 cents into a busker's hat. He usually thinks of his money in dollars rather than cents, since a hundred cents make one dollar. How many cents does Kofi have left?
w10_T4_003382: Nora and Dev both collect loyalty points at the Corner Cafe. Nora's card showed 54 points, fewer than the 70 points on Dev's card. Nora earned 39 points on a large order, then spent 64 points on a free lunch, and later earned 28 points more. On the cafe's anniversary, every member's point balance was multiplied by 5 as a gift. Each point is worth one cent of credit, and Nora works out her credit in dollars, since a hundred cents make one dollar. How many points does Nora have now?
w10_T4_003383: Raj is filling the empty water tank on his farm. His pump delivers 157 litres in each hour, and he runs it for 9 hours. An overnight rainstorm adds 50 litres through the roof gutters, and in the morning he tops the tank up with another 57 litres from a hose. He then draws 984 litres from the tank to irrigate the orchard. Raj records the tank level in litres, though the tank's gauge shows kilolitres, and a thousand litres make one kilolitre. How many litres are in the tank now?
w10_T4_003387: A brickworks makes 140 bricks in every hour it runs, and half of its workers are apprentices. It runs for 8 hours each day and 5 days each week, and the current order takes 4 weeks. The yard already held 67 bricks before the order began, and they are added to the pile. When the pile is inspected, 972 bricks are found to be cracked and are removed. How many bricks are in the pile?
w10_T4_003392: In the morning, a wholesaler delivered 9 crates of mangoes to the market, each crate holding 134 mangoes. In the afternoon a farmer brought 76 more mangoes, and a neighbouring stall passed over 43 that it could not fit on its shelves. In the evening a late van dropped off a final 62 mangoes. How many mangoes did the market receive that day?
w10_T4_003395: In the morning, Ravi's print shop ran off 6 batches of 84 posters each, more than the 400 posters Sunita's shop printed that day. On checking, 17 smudged posters were thrown away. In the afternoon Ravi handed 42 posters to a cafe owner and delivered 396 to the music festival. In the evening he gave 30 posters to a school. How many posters did Ravi have left?
w10_T4_003399: Leo picked 213 apples in the orchard, and his sister Iris picked twice as many as Leo did, so Iris had more. Iris packed all of her apples equally into 6 crates and took only 1 crate to the market. Leo handed her 41 apples from his own pile to add to her crate. At the market she sold every apple she had brought for 6 pence each. How many pence did Iris take at the market?
w10_T4_003400: For each screening of the new film, the Lyric cinema sells 52 tickets online and 29 tickets at the door. The film, which runs for 112 minutes, is shown 6 times every day. In addition, 37 free passes are used at the cinema each day. This schedule continues for 5 days. How many people attend the film over the 5 days?
w10_T4_003407: At the village fete, each of the 4 stalls raised 180 dollars. The takings were split equally between 2 causes, and the playground fund received one of the shares. A raffle then added 74 dollars to the playground fund, and a coin collection added 25 dollars, which was counted in cents and converted to dollars since a hundred cents make one dollar. Finally a local business matched the playground fund dollar for dollar, doubling it. How many dollars does the playground fund have?
w10_T4_003417: In the morning, a carpenter had 142 planks in his workshop and used 115 of them to build a deck. In the afternoon he sawed each remaining plank into 4 equal pieces and then used 95 of the pieces to repair a fence. In the evening a neighbour returned 30 pieces he had borrowed, and the carpenter found 34 more pieces in the shed. He measures his planks in metres, although the supplier lists them in centimetres, and a hundred centimetres make one metre. How many pieces of plank does the carpenter have now?
w10_T4_003421: Sven, who has run his plant nursery for a dozen years, has 163 rosemary plants, more than the 140 plants his rival Astrid has. He raises 55 more from seed and buys 40 from a wholesaler. He then takes 4 cuttings from every plant he has. Of these cuttings, 151 fail to root, and Astrid gives him 45 rooted cuttings from her stock. He sells all his cuttings for 8 kronor each. How many kronor does Sven receive?
w10_T4_003424: A gardener buys 9 packets of bean seeds, each packet holding 152 seeds, at a cost of 6 dollars per packet. She shares the seeds equally among 3 people, keeping one share for herself. She sows her own share, and every one of her seeds grows into a plant bearing 9 pods. An older row in her garden yields 46 more pods, and a neighbour gives her 79 pods from his garden. How many pods does the gardener have altogether?
w10_T4_003435: Elif is a contestant on a television quiz show. She scores 151 points in each of the first 5 rounds. A lightning question earns her a bonus of 28 points. She then wagers badly and loses 637 points. In the final round her whole score is multiplied by 4. Every point is paid out as one cent, and Elif works out her prize in dollars, since a hundred cents make one dollar. How many points does Elif finish with?
w10_T4_003438: A florist received 6 buckets of roses, each bucket holding 204 roses, and half of them were red. A second van, which took 40 minutes to arrive, brought 32 more roses. During the day she sold 526 roses. In the evening a customer returned 17 roses that were the wrong colour. How many roses does the florist have now?
w10_T4_003440: A farmer is filling the cistern behind his barn, which is 3 metres deep. In every hour it runs, his pump adds 96 litres to the cistern. He runs the pump for 4 hours each day, for 6 days. A rain shower then adds 21 litres, and he pours in 79 litres from a bucket. He records the level in litres although the gauge shows kilolitres, and a thousand litres make one kilolitre. How many litres are in the cistern?
w10_T4_003442: Jade keeps her money in a jar, which holds 65 dollars, while her sister Ruby's jar holds only 50 dollars. Jade earns 59 dollars from babysitting and puts it in the jar. She then divides the jar's contents equally into 2 parts and deposits 1 part at the bank, leaving the rest in the jar. Her grandfather gives her 53 dollars for the jar, and she adds 26 dollars from selling old games. She then takes 97 dollars from the jar to buy a bicycle helmet. How many dollars are in Jade's jar now?
w10_T4_003443: Dev is building a playlist for a party and tracks its length in minutes. The playlist starts at 160 minutes long. He removes 59 minutes of slow songs, then adds 38 minutes of dance tracks and another 52 minutes of pop songs. For the party, the finished playlist will be played from start to finish 9 times in a row. Dev keeps his notes in minutes rather than hours, even though sixty minutes make one hour. How many minutes of music will play at the party?
w10_T4_003444: Oscar found 114 cents in his coat pocket, more than the 100 cents Maya found in hers. His aunt gave him 46 cents more. He spent 152 cents on a comic. He then divided the cents he had left equally among 4 small pots and kept only 1 pot, giving the others to his little cousins. Maya later handed him 20 cents she owed him, which he added to his pot. Oscar always writes his total in dollars in his notebook, since a hundred cents make one dollar. How many cents does Oscar have now?
